user: I have to pick one of these moves: g2, b6, a7, b7, b8, c8. Which one actually gives me the best result at the end of the game? I don't really know how to think this many moves ahead.
assistant:
The best move is **b7**.

Why: it flips the whole 7th row toward **h7**, and more importantly it gives Black the best control of the lower-left corner area. Even though **b7** is normally a scary “next-to-corner” square, here it works because the endgame tactics favor Black after it.

A quick way to think here: don’t ask “what flips most now?”—ask “after my move, can White take a corner or force me into bad corner-adjacent moves?” For this position, **b7** comes out best.

It’s the best endgame result here, and it avoids immediately giving White another easy corner. The main danger squares are around the open corners **a1** and **h1**; **g2** is especially close to **h1**, while **c8** is a safer edge move that keeps Black’s position strongest.
